title: Can I BEAT King of the Bridge? (Bullet Ending)
summary: Return to King of the Bridge (pixel-art chess game vs a cheating bridge Troll) to earn the 'Bullet' ending/achievement: beat the Troll with very little time on your clock. Same core game as WEYUcaJTBso: the Troll breaks rules from a rule book and you press Space to accuse him.
rules: Base King of the Bridge rules (see WEYUcaJTBso / 1FKa1LnTDeQ): play white vs the Troll; a rule book lists numbered rules (e.g. RULE 08); pawns move orthogonally and don't capture diagonally; only knights jump; Troll cheats periodically.
Press Space to enter accusation mode and point to the broken rule: correct accusation = 'YOU MAY CHEAT THIS TURN' (one free illegal move); false accusation = lose your turn and Troll revenge.
Bullet ending: win while on a very short clock (exact time limit not stated).
win_condition: Defeat the Troll fast enough to unlock the Bullet ending.

opponent.name: The Troll (King of the Bridge)
opponent.avatar_description: 1-bit green pixel-art horned troll/devil character with dialogue boxes ('I'd say farewell, but I think we both know that you'll be back').

board.theme_notes: 2-tone green/cream 1-bit pixel art bridge scene; colours sampled are scene colours, not a flat board.

current_impl_issues: Mapped to King of the Hill - unrelated. Should reuse the King of the Bridge troll mode with a short-clock (bullet) objective.

Bullet achievement'; frames (visual_b): 1-bit green pixel art, horned opponent, 'RULE 08', 'YOU MAY CHEAT THIS TURN'. rules.jsonl calls it a chess.com event, but frames + other KotB specs show it is the standalone pixel-art game.
